info.title: Sistem Informasi Belanja Santri — API
info.description: Backend REST API PP Nazhatut Thullab. Tiga portal: admin (CRUD santri/staff, laporan, penyesuaian), staff Rumah Koin (penarikan koin, upload & apply mutasi BNI), wali (saldo & riwayat anak). Semua route kecuali /auth/login butuh Authorization: Bearer {token}.
